notes:
Lead: Ryan Li (founder, ex-SaaS PM). Early-stage SMB building a conversational assistant for 2 verticals: customer support and onboarding docs.

Summary of need:
- Primary interest: hosted API (self-serve) — wants simple path to production without infra.
- Workloads: chat (multi-turn support), embeddings for semantic search across docs (~200k docs initially).
- Targets: median generation latency <200ms for short chat prompts; embeddings throughput ~200 reqs/min; cost-sensitive (monthly dev budget ~$2k-$5k to start).
- Model preferences: wants smaller/cheaper open models for cost but needs quality parity w/ Anthropic/OpenAI for safety and helpfulness. Will compare base quality vs price.

Pricing & procurement notes:
- Ryan: "We love OpenAI UX but need ~2–3x better unit cost to make embeddings affordable at scale."
- Asking for sample monthly bill scenarios: 100k tokens chat + 50k embeddings — breakdown per model variant, with and without prefix caching.
- Wants clarity on rate limits, concurrency and how free credits map to spikes. Also curious about reserved burst capacity vs on-the-fly throttling.

Security / compliance:
- SMB; will require SSO (SAML) for admin console later but not blocking initial POC. Audit logging nice-to-have. No data residency requirement yet.

Technical/implementation notes:
- Prototype uses Node SDK; asked about migrating from OpenAI SDK call patterns (compatibility examples helpful).
- Concern about tokenization differences across models; asked for tokenization tooling or examples.
- Interested in Optimize recommendations for batching and embedding caching to reduce cost.

Decision process & timeline:
- Founder-led evaluation; technical co-founder (engineer) will run the POC. Budget sign-off expected from founder in Apr 2026 if cost buckets acceptable.

Open items / ask from AE:
- Provide side-by-side cost model (Redwood hosted vs OpenAI/Anthropic) with assumptions + sample invoice.
- Small POC guidance doc: SDK snippets (node/python), recommended model choices for chat vs embeddings, example caching settings.
- Clarify quota/free-credit timeline and how bursts are handled.

Tone: brisk, pragmatic. Founder wants self-serve but needs pricing confidence to proceed. Short-term goal: 2-week POC, long-term: convert to paid hosted API with monthly usage commit.
